comparison.objective: Pour a mixed coin charge and sort the coins into their proper destinations; candidate fractures and recovers four identical tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Granular pouring, denomination discrimination, repeated picking, and sorting versus bimanual impact and cavity fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Coins transferred and correctly sorted without loss; no notch, retained insert, or impact-damage condition.
comparison.reason: Fragment-sized object handling is only a generic primitive; classification and sorting are central here, while candidate requires producing fragments through controlled fracture.
